method: 84-config search on 2020-2026 15M Dukascopy bid/ask. Executable sides, 0.10pt slippage, adverse-first same-bar, 48h expiry, one-open-per-strategy. In-sample (2020->2025) selection vs out-of-sample (2025->2026) validation; bootstrap 2000x CI + one-sided p-value; Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q=0.10 for multiple testing; Monte-Carlo 5000x fixed-fractional drawdown. Source: research/strategy_search.py.

bollinger_fade_long_v1.label: Bollinger Fade (Long, 1:1)
bollinger_fade_long_v1.rule: BUY when 1H close < lower Bollinger band(20,2); SL & TP = 1.5*ATR (1:1); long-only.
bollinger_fade_long_v1.why: Gold's structural upward drift makes buying oversold dips ride WITH the drift; a tight 1:1 target captures the quick reversion bounce before it fades.

rsi_meanrev_long_v1.label: RSI Mean-Reversion (Long, 1:1)
rsi_meanrev_long_v1.rule: BUY when 1H RSI(14) < 30 AND close is > 1 ATR below EMA20; SL & TP = 1.5*ATR (1:1); long-only.
rsi_meanrev_long_v1.why: Independent oversold trigger confirming the same edge as Bollinger fade: buy stretched dips in an up-drifting market, target the fast bounce.
